整理面板会移动或删除我的文件吗？: Does organizing a panel move or delete my files?
把图标拖入桌面面板只改变收纳方式，原文件留在原处，关闭面板也不会删除文件。文件菜: Dragging icons into a desktop panel stores references only—original files stay in place, and closing a panel never deletes them. File commands such as delete, rename, cut, and folder-panel paste do act on real files.
搜索和空格预览需要额外安装吗？: Do search and Spacebar preview need separate apps?
需要。搜索依赖 Everything；空格预览可使用 PowerToys Pee: Yes. Search connects to Everything, and Spacebar preview works with PowerToys Peek or QuickLook. Install them separately and enable the integration in LucidDesk Settings.
日常使用推荐 setup.exe 安装版。普通 ZIP 免安装，配置保存在本地应: Choose setup.exe for everyday use. Standard ZIP runs without installation and keeps settings in your local app data folder, while Portable stores settings in the app’s data folder. All three include identical features.
需要账号吗？桌面数据存在哪里？: Do I need an account? Where is my data stored?
LucidDesk 无需注册账号，设置和布局主要保存在本机。应用默认通过 Git: No account required. Settings and layouts stay on your PC. Update checks use GitHub by default and can be turned off in Settings. External agents and third-party tools follow their own privacy settings. Read the privacy guide
